question: Which of the following digital portals was launched by the Ministry of Tribal Affairs on 22 January 2021 to collect data related to the tribal migrant workers in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Shram Shakti__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Shram shakti** portal was launched by The **Union Minister of Tribal Affairs** **Arjun Munda** virtually on **22****ⁿd**** January 2021**.
 
• Shram shakti is a **National Migration Support Portal**.
 
• Shram Shakti is a **digital data solution** for capturing **information **regarding **migrant workers**.
 
• **Shram shakti porta**l would address the **data gap** and **empower migrant workers**.
 
• It would **link the migrant population** with the existing **Welfare Scheme** - under **Atmanirbhar Bharat**.
 
• The data in the Shram Shakti will be recorded in **four segments**
 
 
• **Demographic profile,**
 
• **Livelihood,**
 
• **Skill mapping, and**
 
• **Migration Pattern**.
 
 
 
• Expected outcomes by the **Shram Shakti** portals are:
 
 
• **Promoting local livelihood based on the database - promoting Atmanirbhar Bharat**
 
• **Tailor-made program to support migrating families in a targeted manner backed up by data**
 
• **Formulation of suitable strategies and policy decisions for making the existing schemes more effective and beneficiary friendly**
 
• **Immediate support for tribal and other migrant workers in cities for safe and productive migration**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Arjun Munda also launched **ShramSaathi **to ensure the** process of livelihood migration is safe and productive**.
 
• **ShramSaathi **is a **training module** for the **tribal migrant** to understand through which they can **demand and access services**.
 
• **Goa** will be the first **state of India** to set up a **dedicated migration cell** to address **issues of migrant workers**.
